method.gross: sum of the R$ columns REMUNERACAOBASICABRUTAR, ABATETETOR, GRATIFICACAONATALINAR, ABATETETODAGRATIFICACAONATALINAR, FERIASR, OUTRASREMUNERACOESEVENTUAISR (abate-teto is negative in the file, so gross is after the cap)
method.net: REMUNERACAO APOS DEDUCOES OBRIGATORIAS (R$), the file's own column
method.indemnities: TOTAL DE VERBAS INDENIZATORIAS (R$): paid but not salary, outside gross and net
method.usd_not_converted: the U$ columns summed in US dollars, never converted
method.uf: distinct valid UF codes of the person's cadastro rows in the same zip: one UF places the person there; none or two or more go to no_uf (reasons missing_uf, conflicting_uf); a Remuneracao Id absent from the cadastro goes to no_uf (not_in_cadastro); a file with no UF column goes to no_uf (no_uf_column). Nothing is allocated.
method.people: distinct Id_SERVIDOR_PORTAL with gross R$ or U$ above zero in the month; people_avg = mean of the months
